question: The present cost of an apartment is ₹1,70,014. After a year, its cost increased to ₹1,93,900. The percentage increase (rounded off to the nearest integer) in the cost of the apartment is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Cost Increase** = 1,93,900 − 1,70,014 = 23,886

**Percentage Increase** = (23,886 ÷ 1,70,014) × 100

Approximation: 23,886 ≈ 24,000 and 1,70,014 ≈ 1,70,000

24 ÷ 170 × 100 ≈ 14.1%

**∴ The correct answer is 14%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Present Cost (Initial Value)** = ₹1,70,014

**New Cost (Final Value)** = ₹1,93,900

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Increase = [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f1ffad36d94287e67c8246e1a37ba4cfe3003f5ad6b795b5dbcf52d54ebc073.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Absolute Increase = 1,93,900 − 1,70,014 = 23,886

⇒ Percentage Increase = (23,886 ÷ 1,70,014) × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 0.14049... × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase ≈ 14.05%

⇒ Rounded to nearest integer = 14%

**∴ The correct answer is 14%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

It represents the relationship between an old value and a new value. Formula: (Change ÷ Original Value) × 100.

Rounding Off Rules

If the decimal part is 0.5 or greater, round up to the next integer; if less than 0.5, keep the current integer part.

Appreciation and Depreciation

Appreciation refers to an **increase** in the value of an asset over time, while Depreciation refers to a **decrease**.

52
